# Test-set evaluation

> **Second test run (Phase 8), approved by the project owner.** The India consumption model was changed on validation evidence only (ensemble + refit on train + validation; `reports/improvement_experiments.md`) and the test split was scored again. The first run (Phase 5) is kept unchanged in `reports/archive_phase5/`; both are reported. The test split had been seen once before this decision, so the second India number may be slightly optimistic. Solar and France models are unchanged (same file hashes).

*Generated by `python -m solvia.pipeline --steps evaluate`. The models were chosen on validation (Phase 4; India's final model in Phase 8); the test split was scored with them on 2026-10-28T06:00:29+00:00 (UTC). Model file hashes are in `reports/metrics/test_run_log.json`; a run with different model files is refused.*

## B. Expected solar output (Kaggle plants, test days 2020-06-13 … 2020-06-17)

Selected: `hist_gradient_boosting`, per_plant, trained on `healthy_reference`. Healthy inverter-days, both plants: test daily MAE **176.8 kWh** (MAPE 2.76 %, R² 0.964) vs validation 122.5 kWh; 15-minute daytime MAE 33.0 kW (R² 0.960).

## A-India. Next-day consumption, Prayas eMARC (test 2020-01-01 … 06-30)

Final model (Phase 8): equal-weight ensemble of `ridge`, `random_forest`, `hist_gradient_boosting_relative_absolute`, refitted on train + valid. Test MAE **0.679 kWh/day** (validation 0.705), R² 0.913, MAPE 14.6 %; +9.0 % vs the best validation baseline (`baseline_mean_7d`).

**Change since the Phase 5 test run** (`ridge`, trained on train only): MAE valid 0.716 → **0.705**, test 0.711 → **0.679**, test normal 0.673 → **0.644**, test lockdown 0.748 → **0.712**.

MAE (kWh/day) of every baseline and model:

| model | kind | valid | test | test_normal | test_lockdown |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ensemble | ensemble | 0.705 | 0.679 | 0.644 | 0.712 |
| ensemble (members fitted on train only) | model | 0.705 | 0.697 | 0.666 | 0.726 |
| hist_gradient_boosting_relative_absolute | model | 0.715 | 0.721 | 0.664 | 0.775 |
| ridge | model | 0.716 | 0.711 | 0.673 | 0.748 |
| hist_gradient_boosting_relative | model | 0.726 | 0.757 | 0.679 | 0.830 |
| random_forest | model | 0.733 | 0.743 | 0.733 | 0.753 |
| hist_gradient_boosting | model | 0.749 | 0.793 | 0.776 | 0.809 |
| baseline_mean_7d | baseline | 0.763 | 0.746 | 0.694 | 0.796 |
| baseline_yesterday | baseline | 0.798 | 0.775 | 0.755 | 0.795 |
| baseline_last_week | baseline | 1.060 | 1.054 | 0.961 | 1.141 |

Lockdown (from 2020-03-25): selected-model MAE 0.644 on normal days vs 0.712 in lockdown (+7.3 % / +10.5 % vs baseline). Lockdown is a change in behaviour the training data never contained.

Per meter (test): median MAE 0.506 (baseline 0.568) over 104 meters; the model beats the baseline on 86% of meters (77% on normal days, 82% in lockdown).

**Meters seen in training vs new** (test)

| group | rows | meters | mean_kwh | mae | baseline_mae |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| new meter | 184 | 2 | 3.12 | 0.846 | 0.960 |
| seen in training | 15868 | 102 | 5.22 | 0.677 | 0.744 |

**By household type** (test)

| group | rows | meters | mean_kwh | mae | baseline_mae |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | 10335 | 67 | 4.84 | 0.647 | 0.706 |
| Water Heaters but no AC | 3257 | 20 | 5.88 | 0.699 | 0.791 |
| With Air Conditioners | 2460 | 17 | 5.76 | 0.788 | 0.855 |

**By region** (test)

| group | rows | meters | mean_kwh | mae | baseline_mae |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aurangabad | 3373 | 23 | 6.98 | 0.916 | 0.986 |
| Gonda | 1897 | 11 | 5.79 | 0.963 | 1.096 |
| Kanpur rural | 1534 | 10 | 3.29 | 0.509 | 0.558 |
| Pune | 3532 | 23 | 4.23 | 0.605 | 0.645 |
| Pune city | 5716 | 37 | 5.05 | 0.536 | 0.602 |

**80 % prediction interval (test):** raw quantile models cover 78.7% (width 2.26 kWh); after the conformal adjustment from validation (+0.09 kWh each side) 83.0% (width 2.44 kWh).

Calibrated coverage by period: lockdown 83.9%, normal 82.1%.

Calibrated coverage by household_type: Basic 83.1%, Water Heaters but no AC 83.5%, With Air Conditioners 82.0%.

## A-France. Next-day consumption, UCI household (test 2010-01-01 … 11-25)

Selected in Phase 4: `ridge`. Test MAE **4.259 kWh/day** (validation 4.566), R² 0.490, MAPE 18.4 %; +2.7 % vs the best validation baseline (`baseline_mean_7d`).

MAE (kWh/day) of every baseline and model:

| model | kind | valid | test |
|---|---|---|---|
| ridge | model | 4.566 | 4.259 |
| random_forest | model | 4.592 | 4.034 |
| baseline_mean_7d | baseline | 4.825 | 4.375 |
| hist_gradient_boosting | model | 5.158 | 4.505 |
| baseline_last_week | baseline | 5.825 | 5.879 |
| baseline_yesterday | baseline | 6.316 | 5.107 |

**80 % prediction interval (test):** raw quantile models cover 64.2% (width 8.95 kWh); after the conformal adjustment from validation (+2.68 kWh each side) 83.0% (width 14.31 kWh).

## Monitoring and maintenance (C, D)

These are rules on top of the expected-output model, not trained predictors, so they have no test split of their own. They were checked in Phase 4 with simulated faults (0 % false alarms; 99.8 % of 20 % losses caught in one day) and against the plants' own history; see `reports/monitoring_report.md`.
